metadata.description: Official Pubky agent skills for AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini).

plugins.name: pubky
plugins.description: Build on and operate the Pubky protocol. Bundles three skills: `pubky` (build web/server apps with the @synonymdev/pubky JS/WASM and pubky Rust SDKs, pubky-app-specs, the pubkyauth flow, pubky:// /pub storage, and the Nexus read API), `pubky-mobile` (build native iOS/Android/React Native apps with react-native-pubky and pubky-core-ffi), and `pubky-infra` (run and self-host the homeserver, Nexus, pubky-docker stack, homegate, pkdns, and relays). Each skill auto-activates on its own triggers.
